t: Sahl ibn Hunayf al-Ansari died at Kufah after his return from the battle of Siffin and he was very much loved by Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him. On this occasion Amir al-Mu'minin said : Even if a mountain had loved me, it would have crumbled down.

Al-Sayyid al-Radi says : The meaning of this is that since the trial of the man who loves Amir al-Mu'minin will be so, severe troubles would leap towards him, and this is not the case except with the God-fearing, the virtuous and select good.
